title.en: the film festival at the olympion.

line.en: the 67th festival runs 5 to 15 november with 258 films. pick a screening at the olympion on aristotelous square; showtimes are on filmfestival.gr.
line.de: das 67. festival läuft vom 5. bis 15. november mit 258 filmen. ein screening im olympion am aristotelousplatz aussuchen; die zeiten stehen auf filmfestival.gr.
line.tr: 67. festival 5 ila 15 kasım arasında, 258 filmle. aristotelous meydanı'ndaki olympion'da bir gösterim seç; seanslar filmfestival.gr'de.

sparks.why: 67th Thessaloniki International Film Festival runs 5 to 15 Nov 2026 with 258 films at the Olympion (greekcitytimes.com, filmfestival.gr); no screening time was confirmed, so the hour is a suggestion.
